_readme: Challenge names, blurbs, and verdicts (PRD 11.1). Ids match src/balance/challenges.json. Name up to 32 characters, blurb up to 140. A verdict judges the run in one line (up to 100 characters): the game takes the band with the highest `atLeast` that the score reaches, and draws one of its lines on the cosmetic stream. The first band must start at 0. A verdict's id rides in the share link, so keep ids stable and unique inside a challenge: a link whose id is gone shows the band's first line. {score} and {cycles} are filled in. Every line here is a PLACEHOLDER by the engineer, waiting for the owner's content pass.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.blurb: More Raiders, sooner, and more of them shooting. The fleet is the same size. So are you.

lines.text: PLACEHOLDER: The swarm would like to thank you for your participation.
PLACEHOLDER: Dradis ran out of dots. You ran out of fleet.
PLACEHOLDER: Respectable. The Raiders are filing a complaint.
PLACEHOLDER: {cycles} cycles in a hornet's nest. Tyrol is impressed. Quietly.
PLACEHOLDER: {score} points. The swarm is going to need a bigger swarm.
PLACEHOLDER: Somewhere a Cylon is redrawing the attack plan. Again.

tyrol-overwhelmed.name: Tyrol overwhelmed
tyrol-overwhelmed.blurb: The deck crew is three people and a roll of tape. The fleet gets much less repair at each jump.

lines.text: PLACEHOLDER: Tyrol has asked you to stop bringing him things to fix.
PLACEHOLDER: The tape ran out on cycle {cycles}. So did the fleet.
PLACEHOLDER: Held together with tape and optimism. Mostly tape.
PLACEHOLDER: The deck crew slept four minutes. They thank you for all four.
PLACEHOLDER: {score} points and barely a scratch. Tyrol suspects witchcraft.
PLACEHOLDER: Nothing to fix. Tyrol doesn't know what to do with his hands.

endless.name: Endless
endless.blurb: No resurrection ship. Every Raider comes back, and Tyrol mends a little less at every jump. How long can the fleet hold?

lines.text: PLACEHOLDER: All of this has happened before. Quickly, this time.
PLACEHOLDER: The Raiders barely got warmed up.
PLACEHOLDER: A respectable stretch. Tyrol wants a nap about it.
PLACEHOLDER: The Raiders have started taking this personally.
PLACEHOLDER: {score} points. The fleet will tell stories about this. Short ones. They are tired.
PLACEHOLDER: At this point the Raiders are the ones asking when it ends.

weekly._readme: The weekly challenge (PRD 11.1). `name` is short, because it sits beside the outcome on the end screen and the share image; {week} is the week's number. Every swarm and fleet variant in src/balance/challenges.json needs a `name` (up to 24 characters) and a `line` (up to 90) saying what it does. The first of each list is the tier's own numbers: its line shows only when the week pairs it with a change. Verdicts work as for set challenges.
weekly.name: Week {week}
weekly.blurb: A new mix every Monday, 00:00 UTC. Everyone flies the same rules this week.

swarm.name: A bigger swarm
swarm.line: More Raiders, sooner, and more of them shooting.

heavies.name: Heavy traffic
heavies.line: Heavy Raiders from the first cycle, four at a time.

weavers.name: Weavers
weavers.line: Most Raiders weave instead of diving straight.

short-handed.name: Short-handed deck
short-handed.line: Less fleet repair at each jump.

thin-hulls.name: Thin hulls
thin-hulls.line: The fleet can lose more in a single cycle.

lines.text: PLACEHOLDER: This week happened to you. Next week might go the other way.
PLACEHOLDER: The fleet has filed this week under 'lessons'.
PLACEHOLDER: A solid week. CIC is cautiously optimistic, which is new.
PLACEHOLDER: {cycles} jumps. The week's paperwork is nearly bearable.
PLACEHOLDER: {score} points. Put it on the board in the hangar.
PLACEHOLDER: Best week the fleet's had in a while. Don't tell the Cylons.
